property_summary: For any initialize(...) call the contract stores changeFee equal to the provided _changeFee; the mutant overrides that and stores uint56.max instead, so the stored changeFee will differ for some inputs (any _changeFee != type(uint56).max).
change_summary: Replace assignment to changeFee with assigning maximal uint56 value, so stored changeFee differs (large value) after initialize.
